context: A uni student interviews a retired researcher at home
purpose: Teach: 暦/酸化/復元/錯覚/混合/死後/政令/悪影響

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本日はお時間いただきありがとうございます。まず、先生のご専門についてお聞きしたいのですが、研究では旧暦の資料も扱われたとか。
lines.en: Thank you for your time today. First, I'd like to ask about your specialty — I heard you also worked with old lunar calendar records.
lines.style: Polite university student, slightly nervous but eager interviewer tone throughout.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ああ、そうだね。古文書の紙はね、長い年月で酸化が進んで、もう触れただけで崩れそうになるんだよ。
lines.en: Ah, yes. The paper of old documents oxidizes over the years, and it gets so fragile that it almost crumbles just from being touched.
lines.style: Calm elderly researcher with gentle teaching cadence, reflective and measured.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: なるほど。そうした資料をデジタル復元するご研究もされていたんですよね。
lines.en: I see. And you also did research on digitally restoring such materials, right?
lines.style: Curious follow-up delivered in a polite academic register.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: うん。ただね、画像処理で鮮明になると、まるで元通りになったような錯覚に陥るんだが、失われた情報は戻らない。そこは学生さんにも伝えたい点だ。
lines.en: Yes. But you know, when images become clear through processing, you fall into the illusion that everything has been restored — yet lost information doesn't come back. That's a point I want students to understand.
lines.style: Thoughtful warning in a slightly stern but warm mentor voice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 勉強になります。共同研究では理系と文系の混合チームを組まれたと伺いました。難しさはありましたか。
lines.en: That's very instructive. I heard your joint research involved a mixed team of science and humanities scholars. Were there difficulties?
lines.style: Engaged student probing deeper with respectful academic curiosity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 言葉が通じないんだよ、最初はね。それから、ある作家の死後に発見された日記を扱った時は、遺族との調整が一番骨が折れた。
lines.en: We couldn't communicate at first, you know. And when we handled a diary discovered after a certain author's death, coordinating with the bereaved family was the hardest part.
lines.style: Reminiscing candidly in conversational elder storytelling mode.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: そうなんですね。文化財関連の政令が改正された影響もあったのでしょうか。
lines.en: I see. Did the revisions to the cultural property government ordinance also have an impact?
lines.style: Sharp informed question showing prior reading and preparation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 鋭いね。手続きが煩雑になって、若手の研究時間に悪影響が出ているのは事実だよ。君たちの世代こそ、声を上げてほしいな。
lines.en: Sharp observation. It's true that procedures have grown complicated, and it's having a negative impact on young researchers' time. It's your generation that should speak up.
lines.style: Encouraging close in a mentor passing the torch warmly.
